name: GENEA Leaderboard
description: A living benchmark for evaluating conversational motion synthesis and speech-driven gesture generation, with periodic large-scale user studies to compare systems on human-perceived quality and usefulness.
evaluation_method: large_scale_user_studies; human preference ratings on conversational motion synthesis outputs
typical_sota_score: 50–80% (reported as pairwise human-preference win rates for top systems; varies by study and evaluation cohort)
notes: Living leaderboard updated multiple times per year; aims to standardize evaluation beyond easily measurable proxies and capture what actually matters to users.
